annotations.title: Add a person to an order

description: Add a person you found (search_people, match_people) to the shortlist of one of your job orders, at the stage new. The person is told they are on a shortlist; the same rules as get_person apply (people open to agents, the different people of 30 days). Adding someone already there changes nothing. Needs the API key of the Alion account that posted the vacancies. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

order_id.description: The order: the id list_orders gives (an Alion vacancy your account posted).

person.description: The person: person_id (p_...), their Alion handle or an alion.io/user/<handle> link.
